paragraphs: Unless the context otherwise indicates, references herein to "Pentair," the "Company," and such words as "we," "us," and "our" include Pentair plc and its consolidated subsidiaries.

At Pentair, we help the world sustainably move, improve and enjoy water, life's most essential resource. From our residential and commercial water solutions to industrial water management and everything in between, Pentair is an S&P 500 company focused on smart, sustainable water solutions that help our planet and people thrive.
Our vision is to be the world's most valued sustainable water solutions company for our employees, customers and shareholders. As a company, we:
•Focus on growth in our core businesses and strategic initiatives; •Accelerate digital innovation and technology as well as sustainability investments;
•Expedite growth and drive margin expansion through our Transformation Program; and
•Build a high performance growth culture and deliver on our commitments while living our Win Right values.

We are an Irish public limited company that was formed in 2014. We are the successor to Pentair Ltd., a Swiss corporation formed in 2012, and Pentair, Inc., a Minnesota corporation formed in 1966 and our wholly-owned subsidiary, under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the "Exchange Act"). Although our jurisdiction of organization is Ireland, we manage our affairs so that we are centrally managed and controlled in the United Kingdom (the "U.K.") and therefore have our tax residency in the U.K.

On September 17, 2025, as part of our Flow reportable segment, we completed the acquisition of Hydra-Stop, LLC ("Hydra-Stop") for $292.1 million in cash, net of cash acquired, and subject to customary adjustments. Hydra-Stop manufactures specialty insertion valves, line stop fittings and installation equipment.

In December 2024, as part of our Pool reportable segment, we completed the acquisition of G & F Manufacturing, LLC ("G & F Manufacturing") for $116.0 million in cash, net of cash acquired. The net purchase price was comprised of an upfront cash payment of $108.0 million, and the estimated fair value at the acquisition date of a contingent earn-out liability based upon the achievement of certain defined operating results in the two years following the acquisition. G & F Manufacturing manufactures and services pool heat pumps.

Our registered principal office is located at Regal House, 70 London Road, Twickenham, London, TW13QS United Kingdom. Our management office in the United States ("U.S.") is located at 5500 Wayzata Boulevard, Suite 900, Golden Valley, Minnesota.

Pentair is comprised of three reportable segments: Flow, Water Solutions and Pool. The discussions below refer to the Company's reportable segment composition and business activities as of and prior to December 31, 2025. Effective January 1, 2026, we reorganized the composition of our Flow and Water Solutions reportable segments to move our residential and irrigation flow business from our Flow segment to our Water Solutions segment. For further detail on the changes to the Flow and Water Solutions segments as a result of the revised segmentation effective January 1, 2026, refer to the discussion titled "2026 Segment Structure" below. Additional information regarding this revised segmentation is found under the section titled "2026 Revised Segmentation."

The Flow segment aims to deliver water where it is needed, when it is needed, more efficiently and to transform waste into value. This segment designs, manufactures and sells a variety of fluid treatment and pump products and systems, including pressure vessels, gas recovery solutions, membrane bioreactors, wastewater reuse systems and advanced membrane filtration, separation systems, specialty insertion valves, line stop fittings and installation equipment, water disposal pumps, water supply pumps, fluid transfer pumps, turbine pumps, solid handling pumps, and agricultural spray nozzles, while serving the global residential, commercial and industrial markets. These products and systems are used in a range of applications, including fluid delivery, ion exchange, desalination, food and beverage, separation technologies for the oil and gas industry, residential and
municipal wells, water treatment, wastewater solids handling, pressure boosting, circulation and transfer, fire suppression, flood control, agricultural irrigation and crop spray.

For the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, our residential and irrigation flow businesses, which sell pumps focused on residential and agriculture, comprised approximately 36% of Flow sales. Another approximately 30% of Flow sales were from the commercial and infrastructure flow businesses, which sell larger pumps focused on fire suppression, water supply, wastewater and flood control. The remaining approximately 34% of Flow sales were from the industrial solutions business, comprised of applications focused on industrial process and air filtration and sustainable gas.

headings: Risks Relating to Our Business
General global economic and business conditions affect demand for our products.
We compete in attractive markets with a high level of competition, which may result in pressure on our profit margins and limit our ability to maintain or increase the market share of our products.
We may not be able to identify, finance and complete suitable acquisitions and investments, and any completed acquisitions and investments may be unsuccessful or consume significant resources.
We may not achieve some or all of the expected benefits of our business initiatives.
We may experience cost increases and other inflation.
Interruption of our supply chain could affect our ability to produce or deliver our products and could negatively impact our business and profitability.
We are exposed to political, regulatory, economic, trade, and other risks that arise from operating a multinational business.

Changes in U.S. or foreign government administrative policy, including the imposition of, or increases in, tariffs and changes to existing trade agreements, could have a material adverse effect on us.
Failure to achieve and maintain a high level of product and service quality and on-time delivery could damage our reputation with customers and negatively impact our results.
Intellectual property challenges may hinder our ability to develop, engineer and market our products.
We have significant goodwill and intangible assets and future impairment of our goodwill and intangible assets could have a material adverse effect on our results of operations.
A loss of, or material cancellation, reduction, or delay in purchases by, or delivery of products to, one or more of our largest customers could harm our business.
Seasonality of sales and weather conditions could have a material adverse effect on our financial results.

Volatility in currency exchange rates and failure to effectively hedge our exposure to fluctuations could have a material adverse effect on our financial condition, results of operations and cash flows.
Our business may be adversely affected by matters associated with our labor force.
Complications with the design or implementation of our updated enterprise resource planning system could adversely impact our business and operations.
Risks Relating to Our Debt and Financial Markets
Increased leverage may harm our business, financial condition and results of operations.
Covenants in our debt instruments may adversely affect us.
Disruptions in the financial markets could adversely affect us, our customers and our suppliers by increasing funding costs or reducing availability of credit.
Risks Relating to Legal, Regulatory and Compliance Matters
Violations of the U.S. Foreign Corrupt Practices Act, U.K. Bribery Act, and other anti-corruption laws outside the U.S. could have a material adverse effect on us.
Our failure to satisfy international trade compliance regulations, and changes in U.S. government and other applicable sanctions, could have a material adverse effect on us.
We are exposed to environmental, health and safety laws, liabilities and litigation.
Our subsidiaries are party to asbestos-related litigation that could adversely affect our financial condition, results of operations and cash flows.
Failure to comply with the broad range of standards, laws and regulations in the jurisdictions in which we operate may result in exposure to substantial disruptions, costs and liabilities.
We are exposed to certain regulatory, financial and other risks related to climate change and other sustainability matters.
paragraphs: You should carefully consider all of the information in this document and the following risk factors before making an investment decision regarding our securities. Any of the following risks could materially and adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations, cash flows and the actual outcome of matters as to which forward-looking statements are made in this document.

We compete in various geographic regions and product markets around the world. Among these, the most significant are global industrial, commercial, and residential markets. We have experienced, and expect to continue to experience, fluctuations in revenues and results of operations due to economic and business cycles. Important factors for our businesses and the businesses of our customers and suppliers include the overall strength of the global economy and various regional economies and our customers' confidence in these economies, industrial and governmental capital spending, the strength of residential and commercial real estate markets, residential housing markets, the food service industry, the commercial business climate, global supply chain stability, possible tariff increases, unemployment rates, availability of consumer and commercial financing, interest rates, inflation rates and energy and commodity prices. Recessions, economic downturns, inflation, slowing economic growth and social and political instability in the industries and/or markets where we compete could negatively affect our revenues and financial performance in future periods, result in future restructuring charges and adversely impact our ability to grow or sustain our business. For example, current macroeconomic and political instability, inflation and the strength or weakness of the U.S. dollar have, and could continue to, adversely impact our results of operations. In addition, military conflicts, such as those between Russia and Ukraine and in the Middle East, and their impact on economies, may adversely impact our results of operations. The businesses of many of our industrial customers are to varying degrees cyclical and have experienced periodic downturns. While we attempt to minimize our exposure to economic or market fluctuations by serving a balanced mix of end markets and geographic regions, any of the above factors, individually or in the aggregate, or a significant or sustained downturn in a specific end market or geographic region could reduce demand for our products and services, which could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition, results of operations and cash flows.

The markets for our products and services are geographically diverse and highly competitive. We compete against large and well-established national and global companies, regional and local companies, diversified and pure-play companies, and lower-cost manufacturers. Competition may also result from new entrants into, or consolidation among competitors in, the markets we serve offering products and/or services that compete with ours. We compete based on technical expertise, intellectual property, reputation for quality and reliability, timeliness of delivery, previous installation history, contractual terms, service offerings, customer experience and service and price. Some of our competitors attempt to compete based primarily on price, localized expertise and local relationships, especially with respect to products and applications that do not require a great deal of engineering or technical expertise. In addition, during economic downturns, average selling prices tend to decrease as market participants compete more aggressively on price. Moreover, demand for our products, which impacts profit margins, is affected by changes in customer order patterns, such as changes in the levels of inventory maintained by customers and the timing of customer purchases, adoption of new technology and connected products, and changes in customers' preferences for our products, including the success of products offered by our competitors. Customer purchasing behavior may also shift by product mix in the market or result in a shift to new distribution channels. Furthermore, new entrants into, or consolidation among competitors in, the markets we serve may result in new ways to bring products and services to market, which, in turn may negatively impact our profit margins. If we are unable to continue to differentiate our products, services and solutions or adapt to changes in customer purchasing behavior or shifts in distribution channels, or if we are unable to maintain our desired pricing or forced to incur additional costs to remain competitive, it could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition, results of operations and cash flows.

Our future growth is dependent upon our ability to transform and adapt our products, services, solutions and organization to meet the demands of local markets in both developed and emerging economies and by developing or acquiring new technologies that achieve market acceptance with acceptable margins.

We operate in global markets that are characterized by customer demand that is often global in scope but localized in delivery. We compete with numerous smaller regional and local companies that may be positioned to offer products produced at lower cost than ours, or to capitalize on highly localized relationships and knowledge that are difficult for us to replicate. Also, in several markets, potential customers prefer local suppliers, in some cases because of existing relationships and in other cases because of local legal restrictions or incentives that favor local businesses. In addition, we need to be flexible to adapt our products to ever changing customer preferences, including those relating to climate change and sustainability matters as well as regulatory requirements. We have identified specific product and geographic market opportunities that we find attractive and

continue to pursue, both within and outside the U.S. We expect to continue investing in our businesses to drive these opportunities through research and development and additional sales and marketing resources. Unless we successfully penetrate these markets, our core sales growth will likely be limited or may decline. Accordingly, our future success depends upon a number of factors, including our ability to transform and adapt our products, services, solutions, organization, workforce and sales strategies to fit localities throughout the world; identify emerging technological and other trends in our target end markets; and develop or acquire competitive technologies, products, services and solutions and bring them to market quickly and cost-effectively. We must also monitor emerging technologies, such as artificial intelligence, and business models, and we may not be able to take advantage of such technologies, which could include not being able to attract and retain talent that would enable us to leverage such technologies. Our competitors may be more successful in their technology strategy and develop superior products and services with the aid of emerging technologies. In addition, the markets for our products, services and solutions may not develop or grow as we anticipate. The failure of our products, services or solutions to gain market acceptance due to more attractive offerings by our competitors, the introduction of new competitors to the market with new or innovative product offerings or the failure to address any of the above factors could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition, results of operations and cash flows.

Pentair plc and its consolidated subsidiaries ("we," "us," "our," "Pentair" or the "Company") is a pure play water industrial manufacturing company comprised of three reportable segments: Flow, Water Solutions and Pool. We classify our operations into business segments based primarily on types of products offered and markets served. For the year ended December 31, 2025, the Flow, Water Solutions and Pool reportable segments represented approximately 37%, 25% and 38% of total consolidated net sales, respectively.

Effective January 1, 2026, we reorganized the composition of our Flow and Water Solutions reportable segments to move our residential and irrigation flow business from our Flow segment into our Water Solutions segment, reflecting how we expect to manage our business in 2026. The Pool segment remains unchanged. The discussions and figures below refer to the Company's reportable segment composition as of and prior to December 31, 2025. Additional information regarding this revised segmentation is found under the section titled "2026 Revised Segmentation" in ITEM 1 of this Form 10-K.

Although our jurisdiction of organization is Ireland, we manage our affairs so that we are centrally managed and controlled in the United Kingdom (the "U.K.") and therefore have our tax residency in the U.K.

On September 17, 2025, as part of our Flow reportable segment, we completed the acquisition of Hydra-Stop, LLC ("Hydra-Stop") for $292.1 million in cash, net of cash acquired, and subject to customary adjustments. Hydra-Stop manufactures specialty insertion valves, line stop fittings and installation equipment.

In December 2024, as part of our Pool reportable segment, we completed the acquisition of G & F Manufacturing, LLC ("G & F Manufacturing") for $116.0 million in cash, net of cash acquired. The net purchase price was comprised of an upfront cash payment of $108.0 million, and the estimated fair value at the acquisition date of a contingent earn-out liability based upon the achievement of certain defined operating results in the two years following the acquisition. G & F Manufacturing manufactures and services pool heat pumps.
The following trends and uncertainties affected our financial performance in 2025 and are reasonably likely to impact our results in the future:

•We have a Transformation Program designed to accelerate growth and drive margin expansion by driving operational excellence, reducing complexity and streamlining our processes. During 2025, we made strategic progress on our Transformation Program initiatives with a focus on our four key themes of pricing excellence, sourcing excellence, operations excellence and organizational effectiveness. We expect to continue executing on our key Transformation Program initiatives to drive margin expansion and to incur transformation costs in 2026 and beyond.

•In 2025, we implemented 80/20 guiding principles to enable our Transformation Program. As we continue to focus on 80/20 principles in 2026, we expect to create value by increasing focus on key customers and products through quadrant-based strategies. This approach will enable improved operating performance by driving margin growth with our highest value customers, reducing lower margin sales and removing complexity in the future.

•In 2025, we executed certain business restructuring initiatives aimed at reducing our fixed cost structure and realigning our business. We expect these actions to continue into 2026 and to drive margin expansion.

•During 2025, we experienced inflationary cost increases for certain raw materials as well as logistics and transportation costs. The ongoing volatile market for commodities has the potential to continue to drive price increases in our supply chain. In addition, the current U.S. administration has implemented tariffs with an ongoing possibility of implementing additional, or increasing current, tariffs. We expect these actions and additional reactionary tariff adjustments by other countries to continue to impact our business and contribute to inflationary cost increases. As a result, we have taken actions to mitigate the impact of tariffs such as pricing increases, inventory pre-buys and supply chain optimization actions, which may continue going forward. In addition, our Transformation Program initiatives are intended to improve productivity and offset cost increases. We anticipate that supply chain pressures and inflationary cost increases resulting from these tariffs, as well as any related impacts on macroeconomic conditions and our business, will likely continue into 2026. In addition, on February 20, 2026, the U.S. Supreme Court struck down certain tariffs imposed under the International Emergency Powers Act. It is unclear at this time what impact this decision will have on our future financial results, including whether we will be able to obtain refunds of amounts previously collected for such tariffs or the level of replacement tariffs the current U.S. Administration imposes through other means.

•The Organization for Economic Co-operation and Development Pillar Two Model Rules ("Pillar Two") for a global 15.0% minimum tax have been adopted by a number of jurisdictions in which we operate. Pillar Two has negatively impacted our effective tax rate in 2025 and is likely to continue to impact our effective tax rate in the future. We continue to evaluate the enacted legislative changes and new guidance as it becomes available.

•We have identified specific product and geographic market opportunities that we find attractive and continue to pursue, both within and outside the U.S. We expect to continue investing in our businesses to drive these opportunities through research and development and additional sales and marketing resources. paragraphs: 除非文意另有所指， herein 所提及之 "Pentair," "the Company," 以及 "we," "us," 和 "our" 皆包含 Pentair plc 及其合併子公司。
在 Pentair，我們協助世界可持續地移動、改善並享受水，這是生命最重要的資源。從我們的住宅與商業用水解決方案，到工業用水管理，以及其中所有內容，Pentair 是一間 S&P 500 公司，專注於智慧且可持續的用水解決方案，以協助我們的星球與人們繁榮發展。
我們的願景是成為全球最受重視的可持續用水解決方案公司，為我們的員工、客戶與股東。作為一家公司，我們：
• 聚焦於核心業務與戰略計畫的成長；• 加速數位創新與科技以及可持續性投資；
• 透過我們的轉型計畫加速成長並擴大毛利率；以及
• 建立高績效成長文化，並履行我們的承諾，同時實踐我們的 Win Right 價值觀。

我們是一間愛爾蘭公開有限公司，於 2014 年成立。我們是 Pentair Ltd. 的繼承者，這是一家於 2012 年成立的瑞士公司，以及 Pentair, Inc.，這是一家於 1966 年成立的明尼蘇達州公司，為我們的 wholly-owned subsidiary，根據 1934 年證券交易法（the "Exchange Act"）進行註冊。雖然我們的註冊地為愛爾蘭，但我們管理財務事務的方式是讓我們在英國（the "U.K."）進行中央管理與控制，因此我們的稅務居所為英國。
於 2025 年 9 月 17 日，作為我們 Flow 應報告分部的一部分，我們完成了對 Hydra-Stop, LLC（"Hydra-Stop"）的收購，以現金 2.921 億美元進行，扣除所取得現金後，並根據慣例進行調整。Hydra-Stop 生產特殊插入閥門、線路停止接頭及安裝設備。
本公司已登記之主要辦公室位於英國倫敦Twickenham區Regal House, 70 London Road, Twickenham, London, TW13QS。本公司美國（"U.S."）之管理辦公室位於Minnesota州Golden Valley市5500 Wayzata Boulevard, Suite 900。

Pentair由三個應報告分部組成：Flow、Water Solutions與Pool。以下討論內容係指本公司截至2025年12月31日之應報告分部組成與業務活動。自2026年1月1日起，我們重新調整Flow與Water Solutions應報告分部之組成，將住宅與灌溉用流體業務從Flow分部移至Water Solutions分部。有關2026年1月1日起調整後Flow與Water Solutions分部之變動詳情，請參閱下文標題為"2026 Segment Structure"的討論。有關此調整後分部之更多資訊，請參閱標題為"2026 Revised Segmentation"的節目。

Flow分部旨在更有效率地將水送至所需之處與所需之時，並將廢棄物轉化為價值。此分部設計、製造與銷售多種流體處理與泵浦產品與系統，包括壓力容器、氣體回收解決方案、膜生物反應器、廢水再利用系統與先進膜過濾、分離系統、專用插入閥門、線路停止接頭與安裝設備、水處理泵浦、水供應泵浦、流體轉移泵浦、渦輪泵浦、固體處理泵浦與農業噴霧噴頭，同時服務全球住宅、商業與工業市場。這些產品與系統應用於多種應用場景，包括流體配送、離子交換、海水淡化、食品與飲料、石油與天然氣產業之分離技術、住宅與
市區井、水處理、廢水固體處理、壓力增強、循環與轉移、火災抑制、水患控制、農業灌溉與作物噴灑。
2025年財務年度截至2025年12月31日，我們的住宅與灌溉流體業務，銷售專注於住宅與農業之泵浦，約佔Flow銷售額的36%。另一約30%的Flow銷售額來自商業與基礎設施流體業務，銷售較大型泵浦，專注於火災抑制、水供應、廢水與水患控制。剩餘約34%的Flow銷售額來自工業解決方案業務，包含專注於工業流程與空氣過濾與可持續氣體之應用。

paragraphs: 本報告包含我們認為符合1995年私人訴訟改革法案所定義之「向前看聲明」之陳述。所有陳述，除歷史事實外，皆為向前看聲明。不限於此，任何以「目標」、「計畫」、「相信」、「預期」、「意圖」、「將」、「可能」、「預期」、「估計」、「預測」、「應該」、「將」、「可能」、「位置」、「策略」或「未來」等詞語開頭或結尾，或包含相似含義之詞語、短語或術語，或其否定形式之陳述，皆為向前看聲明。這些向前看聲明並非未來表現之保證，且受風險、不確定性、假設及其他因素影響，部分因素為我們所無法控制，這些因素可能導致實際結果與這些向前看聲明所表達或暗示者有重大差異。這些因素包括影響我們業務之總體經濟與商業條件，包括住宅及相關市場之強度，以及國際衝突相關條件；與我們服務之市場相關之供給、需求、物流、競爭及價格壓力；達成我們重整計畫、成本削減措施及轉型計畫之效益之能力；原材料、物流及勞動成本及其他通貨膨脹之影響；貨幣兌換率及利率之波動；市場未能接受新產品推出及升級之失敗；成功識別、融資、完成及整合收購之能力；經營海外業務之相關風險；銷售季節性及天氣條件之影響；我們遵守法律及法規之能力；法律、法規及行政政策之變更影響，包括限制美國稅務優惠或影響貿易協議及關稅之法規；訴訟及政府程序之結果；以及達成我們長期戰略營運及永續目標及目標之能力。有關這些及其他因素之額外資訊，請參閱我們向美國證券交易委員會（「SEC」）提交之文件，包括本年度10-K表報。所有向前看聲明僅為本報告之日期所陳述。Pentair不承擔任何義務，亦否認任何義務，更新本報告所包含之資訊。
Pentair plc及其合併子公司（「我們」、「我們」、「我們」、「Pentair」或「本公司」）為一家專注於水產業之製造公司，包含三個應報告分部：Flow、Water Solutions及Pool。我們根據所提供產品類型及服務市場，將業務分為不同分部。截至2025年12月31日財年，Flow、Water Solutions及Pool應報告分部分別佔總合併淨銷售額約37%、2、25%及38%。
自2026年1月1日起，我們重新組合Flow及Water Solutions應報告分部之組成，將我們住宅及灌溉Flow業務從Flow分部移至Water Solutions分部，反映我們預期於2026年如何管理業務。Pool分部保持不變。以下討論及數據指本公司截至及截至2025年12月31日之應報告分部組成。有關此重新分類之額外資訊，請參閱本10-K表報第1項標題為「2026年重新分類」之部分。
雖然我們之組織所在地為愛爾蘭，但我們管理業務方式為中央管理及控制於英國（「英國」），因此我們之稅務居所為英國。
2025年9月17日，作為我們Flow應報告分部之一部分，我們完成對Hydra-Stop, LLC（「Hydra-Stop」）之收購，以現金2.921億美元，扣除所收現金，並受常規調整條款限制。Hydra-Stop製造專用插入閥、線停止接頭及安裝設備。
2024年12月，作為我們Pool應報告分部之一部分，我們完成對G & F Manufacturing, LLC（「G & F Manufacturing」）之收購，以現金1.16億美元，扣除所收現金。淨購價包含一筆 upfront 現金支付1.08億美元，以及於收購日取得之或有支付義務之公平價值，基於收購後兩年內達成特定營運成果之預估。G & F Manufacturing製造及服務泳池熱泵。
以下趨勢及不確定性影響我們2025年之財務表現，並合理可能影響我們未來之結果：
•我們有轉型計畫，旨在加速成長並推動毛利率擴張，透過推動運營卓越、減少複雜性及簡化流程。於2025年，我們在轉型計畫之策略上取得進展，重點為我們四大關鍵主題：價格卓越、採購卓越、運營卓越及組織效能。我們預期會繼續執行我們關鍵轉型計畫，以推動毛利率擴張，並於2026年及以後產生轉型成本。
•於2025年，我們實施了80/20指導原則以啟動我們的轉型計畫。隨著我們持續聚焦於80/20原則，我們預期透過基於四象限的策略，增加對關鍵客戶與產品的關注，以創造價值。此方法將透過推動與我們最高價值客戶的毛利率成長，來提升營運表現，同時減少低毛利率銷售並去除未來的複雜性。
•於2025年，我們執行了某些業務重整計畫，旨在降低固定成本結構並重新調整業務。我們預期這些行動會持續至2026年，並推動毛利率擴張。

•於2025年，我們經歷了某些原材料的通貨膨脹成本增加，以及物流與運輸成本的增加。持續的產業商品市場波動有潛力繼續推動我們供應鏈的價格上漲。此外，當前美國政府已實施關稅，並有持續實施更多或提高現有關稅的可能性。我們預期這些行動以及其他國家可能實施的反應性關稅調整，會繼續影響我們的業務並導致通貨膨脹成本增加。因此，我們已採取行動以緩解關稅的影響，例如價格上調、存貨預購及供應鏈優化措施，這些措施可能持續進行。此外，我們的轉型計畫措施旨在提高生產力並抵消成本增加。我們預期這些關稅導致的供應鏈壓力與通貨膨脹成本增加，以及任何相關對總體經濟狀況與我們業務的影響，將很可能持續至2026年。此外，於2026年2月20日，美國最高法院廢除了國際緊急權力法案下某些關稅。目前尚不清楚此決定對我們未來財務結果的影響，包括我們是否能獲得先前收取這些關稅金額的退款，或當前美國政府透過其他方式所實施的替代關稅水準。
•經濟合作與發展組織（Organization for Economic Co-operation and Development）第二支柱模型規則（"Pillar Two"）針對全球15.0%最低稅率已為我們營運的多個司法管轄區域所採納。Pillar Two已對我們2025年的有效稅率產生負面影響，並可能持續影響我們未來的有效稅率。我們持續評估已實施的立法變更與新指引，並在有新資訊時進行評估。
•我們已識別出特定產品與地理市場的機會，這些機會我們認為具有吸引力，並持續追求，無論是在美國國內或美國以外。我們預期會持續投資於我們的業務，以推動這些機會，透過研究與發展以及額外的銷售與行銷資源。除非我們成功打入這些市場，否則我們的核心銷售成長將可能受到限制或下降。
於2026年，我們的營運目標聚焦於交付我們的核心業務並建立未來的業務。我們預期透過以下方式執行這些目標：

headings: 與我們業務相關的風險
全球總體經濟與商業環境會影響我們產品的 demand。
我們在競爭激烈的市場中競爭，這可能會對我們的毛利率造成壓力，並限制我們維持或增加產品市佔率的能力。
我們可能無法識別、籌資並完成合適的併購與投資，且任何完成的併購與投資可能失敗，或消耗大量資源。
我們可能無法實現部分或全部預期的業務計畫效益。
我們可能面臨成本增加和其他通貨膨脹。
我們供應鏈中斷可能影響我們生產或交付產品的能力，並可能對我們的業務與獲利造成負面影響。
我們經營跨國業務，會面臨政治、法規、經濟、貿易及其他相關風險。
美國或外國政府行政政策的變更，包括課徵關稅或提高關稅，以及現有貿易協議的變更，可能對本公司產生重大不利影響。
未能達成並維持高水準的產品與服務品質及準時交貨，可能損害客戶對本公司的聲譽，並對本公司結果產生負面影響。
智慧財產權的挑戰可能影響本公司開發、工程及行銷產品的能力。
本公司擁有重大商譽及無形資產，未來若發生商譽及無形資產減損，可能對本公司營運結果產生重大不利影響。
若失去，或主要客戶大幅取消、減少或延遲購買，或產品交付受阻，可能對本公司業務造成損害。
銷售季節性及天氣條件可能對本公司財務結果產生重大不利影響。
貨幣兌換率的波動及未能有效對衝波動風險，可能對本公司財務狀況、營運結果及現金流產生重大不利影響。
本公司業務可能因勞動力相關事項而受到不利影響。
本公司更新企業資源規劃系統之設計或實施過程若出現問題，可能對本公司業務及營運造成不利影響。
與本公司債務及財務市場相關之風險
財務槓桿增加可能損害本公司業務、財務狀況及營運成果。
本公司債務工具中之約束條款可能對本公司造成不利影響。
財務市場之動盪可能對本公司、客戶及供應商造成不利影響，例如增加資金成本或降低信貸可取得性。
與法律、法規及合規事項相關之風險
違反美國反貪污法、英國貪污法及其他美國境外之反貪污法規，可能對本公司造成重大不利影響。
本公司未能符合國際貿易合規法規，以及美國政府及其他適用之制裁措施之變更，可能對本公司造成重大不利影響。
我們面臨環境、健康與安全法規、責任及訴訟的風險。
我們的子公司參與與石棉相關的訴訟，此等訴訟可能對我們的財務狀況、營運成果及現金流產生不利影響。
未能遵守我們營運所在司法管轄區廣泛的標準、法規及規則，可能導致面臨重大幹擾、成本及責任。
我們面臨與氣候變遷及其他永續議題相關的某些法規、財務及其他風險。
paragraphs: 您應仔細審閱本文件內的所有資訊以及下列風險因素，再做投資決策。任何下列風險都可能對本公司業務、財務狀況、營運結果、現金流量以及本文件中所做之預測性陳述所涉及事項的實際結果造成重大且不利的影響。

我們在世界各地的各種地理區域和產品市場進行競爭。其中最重要的包括全球工業、商業及住宅市場。我們已經驗過，並預期將持續經驗因經濟與商業週期所導致的營收與營運結果波動。對我們業務及我們客戶與供應商業務而言，重要因素包括全球經濟與各區域經濟的整體強度，以及客戶對這些經濟的信心，工業與政府的資本支出，住宅與商業不動產市場的強度，住宅住宅市場，餐飲產業，商業營運氣候，全球供應鏈穩定性，可能的關稅增加，失業率，消費者與商業融資的可得性，利率，通貨膨脹率以及能源與原物料價格。我們所競爭的產業與/或市場若發生衰退、經濟低迷、通貨膨脹、經濟成長放緩以及社會與政治不穩定，可能會對我們未來期間的營收與財務表現造成負面影響，導致未來重整費用，並不利於我們業務的成長或維持。例如，目前的總體經濟與政治不穩定、通貨膨脹以及美元強弱，已並可能持續對我們的營運結果造成負面影響。此外，軍事衝突，例如俄羅斯與烏克蘭之間以及中東地區的衝突，以及其對經濟的影響，也可能對我們的營運結果造成負面影響。我們許多工業客戶的業務在不同程度上具有週期性，並已經驗過週期性的低迷。雖然我們試圖透過服務多樣化的終端市場與地理區域來降低對經濟或市場波動的風險，但上述任何因素，單獨或合計，或特定終端市場或地理區域的重大或持續低迷，都可能降低對我們產品與服務的需求，這可能會對我們的業務、財務狀況、營運結果與現金流量造成重大不利影響。

我們產品與服務的市場地理上相當分散且競爭激烈。我們與許多大型且具規模的國家與全球公司、區域與地方公司、多元化與純粹型公司以及低成本製造商競爭。競爭也可能來自於新進企業進入，或競爭者之間的併購，提供與我們競爭的產品與/或服務。我們的競爭優勢基於技術專業、智慧財產權、品質與可靠性的聲譽、交貨的及時性、過去安裝紀錄、契約條款、服務方案、客戶經驗與服務以及價格。我們的一些競爭對手主要以價格為競爭重點，並利用本地化專業與關係，特別是在不需要大量工程或技術專業的產品與應用上。此外，在經濟低迷期間，平均銷售價格往往會下降，因為市場參與者在價格上競爭更為激烈。此外，影響我們產品利潤率的需求，會受到客戶訂單模式的變化所影響，例如客戶維持的存貨水準變動、客戶購買時間、新技術與連網產品的採用，以及客戶對我們產品的偏好變動，包括競爭對手產品的成功程度。客戶的購買行為也可能因市場中的產品組合而改變，或導致轉向新的銷售通路。此外，新進企業進入，或競爭者之間的併購，可能導致新的產品與服務上市方式，這會進一步對我們的利潤率造成負面影響。如果我們無法持續區隔我們的產品、服務與解決方案，或無法適應客戶購買行為的變化或銷售通路的轉變，或如果我們無法維持所期望的價格或被迫增加成本以保持競爭力，這可能會對我們的業務、財務狀況、營運結果與現金流量造成重大不利影響。
我們未來的成長取決於我們能否轉變與適應我們的產品、服務、解決方案與組織，以符合開發中與新興經濟體的本地市場需求，並透過開發或收購能獲得市場接受度且具有可接受利潤率的新技術。

我們在國際市場運作，這些市場的客戶需求通常具有全球性，但交付則為本地化。我們與許多較小的區域與地方公司競爭，這些公司可能提供成本較低的產品，或能利用難以被我們複製的本地化關係與知識。此外，在幾個市場中，潛在客戶偏好本地供應商，有時是因為現有的關係，有時則是因為本地法律限制或鼓勵本地企業的法律條文。此外，我們需要靈活適應客戶不斷變化的偏好，包括與氣候變遷與永續議題相關的內容，以及法規要求。我們已識別出一些具吸引力的產品與地理市場機會，

並持續追求，無論是在美國國內或國外。我們預期會持續投資於業務，以透過研究與發展以及增加銷售與行銷資源來推動這些機會。除非我們成功打入這些市場，否則我們的核心銷售成長可能受到限制，甚至下降。因此，我們的未來成功取決於許多因素，包括我們能否轉變與適應我們的產品、服務、解決方案、組織、人力與銷售策略，以符合全球各地的本地需求；識別我們目標終端市場中出現的技術與其他趨勢；以及開發或收購具競爭力的技術、產品、服務與解決方案，並快速且成本效益地推向市場。我們還必須監測新興技術，例如人工智慧，以及商業模式，我們可能無法利用這些技術，這可能包括無法吸引並留住能讓我們善用這些技術的人才。我們的競爭對手可能在技術策略上更成功，並藉助新興技術開發出更優秀的產品與服務。此外，我們產品、服務與解決方案的市場可能不會如我們預期般發展或成長。我們的產品、服務或解決方案若因競爭對手更具吸引力的產品、新進企業進入市場推出新穎或創新產品，或未能解決上述任何因素而無法獲得市場接受，這可能會對我們的業務、財務狀況、營運結果與現金流量造成重大不利影響。
